vdbh.label: van den Bergh & Herbst (1975) southern reflection nebulae

method: R-band mag/arcsec^2 (Vega). Planetary nebulae take the mean of their Strasbourg-ESO H-beta flux over the optical disk; emission nebulae at least 12 arcmin across take the peak H-alpha excess of the 6-arcmin Finkbeiner map within their catalogued extent (the frozen mask peak where a mask exists). Others are estimated from photographic plate classes: Lynds classes step one magnitude each from a zero point of 21.13 (the median offset of the measurements they overlap), and reflection-nebula classes map linearly onto the Lynds classes of the nebulae both catalogues list. The remaining few keep their hand estimate, shifted by 1.36 mag (the median offset of the measurements it overlaps); supernova remnants the map cannot isolate are capped at the H-alpha peak of their field.
